name: Digital Twin for Multi-Robot Construction Task Allocation
description: A Digital Twin-based evaluation environment for adaptive multi-robot task allocation on construction sites. A physical construction site is synchronized with its digital model via ROS data streams, and an LLM interprets natural language updates from human operators to automatically modify constraints in an Integer Programming (IP) model for task allocation. This creates a closed-loop system where the virtual environment reflects and influences physical operations in real time.
reputation: Research prototype demonstrating narrative-driven LLM adaptation of constraint-based optimization in a real-time synchronized digital twin setting.
notes: Combines LLM natural language understanding with Integer Programming for task allocation. ROS provides the physical-digital synchronization backbone. Narrative-driven updates preserve human flexibility in the loop without manual constraint coding.
